description: Source code implementing DiagnosticErrorListener for ANTLR in Go, used for identifying grammar correctness and performance issues.

classes.name: DiagnosticErrorListener
classes.description: Implements ANTLRErrorListener to report ambiguities, context sensitivities, and prediction issues during parsing.

methods.name: NewDiagnosticErrorListener
methods.description: Constructor for DiagnosticErrorListener, sets whether to report only exact ambiguities.

methods.name: ReportAmbiguity
methods.description: Reports ambiguity issues during parsing if conditions are met.

methods.name: ReportAttemptingFullContext
methods.description: Reports attempts to resolve full context during parsing.

methods.name: ReportContextSensitivity
methods.description: Reports context sensitivity issues during parsing.

methods.name: getDecisionDescription
methods.description: Provides a textual description of the decision point in the parser.

methods.name: getConflictingAlts
methods.description: Computes and returns the set of conflicting or ambiguous alternatives.
